rci1_using_msad.detail: Each normative model is trained on HCs from a single site with a single scanner. Discovery dataset: First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University (1 GE Discovery MR750 scanner). Replication dataset: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (1 GE Discovery MR750 scanner).
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The discovery dataset included 105 nevertreated first-episode patients with depression and matched 130 healthy controls (HCs) recruited from the first out-patient services of Department of Psychiatry, the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University."; "The functional and T1-weighted anatomical images were acquired on 3-Tsela GE Discovery MR750 scanner"; "The replication dataset included 106 patients with depression and matched 126 HCs."; "The structural and functional images were acquired on a 3-Tesla GE Discovery MR750 scanner"
rci1_using_msad.location: Han2024A.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L81; Methods / Scan acquisition, L93 and L97

rci2_using_epd.detail: All reference data are in-house recruited from two Chinese hospitals. Discovery HCs recruited from the community via poster advertisement at First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University. Replication HCs recruited from the community via poster advertisements at UESTC.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Healthy controls (HCs) were recruited from the community through poster advertisement."; "HCs (n = 126) were recruited from the community through poster advertisements and interviewed using SCID (nonpatient edition)."
rci2_using_epd.location: Han2024A.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L83 and L87

rci3_epd_name.detail: RCI-2 = No; all reference data are in-house datasets

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HCs. Two separate Gaussian process regression normative models were trained on HCs from each dataset independently. All HCs in each dataset served as the training reference cohort (no train/test split mentioned for NM).
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The discovery dataset included 105 nevertreated first-episode patients with depression and matched 130 healthy controls (HCs)"; "The replication dataset included 106 patients with depression and matched 126 HCs."; "we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs and then applied the trained model to infer regional GMV of patients"
rci5_n.location: Han2024A.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L81; Methods / Determination of individualized gray matter atrophy pattern, L109

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase. Male percentages reported in Table 1; male_n and female_n estimated from reported male percentage and total N. Discovery: 45.38% male of N=130 → 59 males, 71 females. Replication: 47.17% male of N=126 → ~59 males (closest integer; 59/126=46.83%, slight discrepancy with reported 47.17%), 67 females.

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; age in years; mean and SD reported directly in Table 1; age range (min-max) not reported for HCs
